answer: Reviewers post a stake to grade, and a random spot check re-grades a fraction of their work; a mismatch costs the stake. Trust attaches to the task, not the address, so an identity is priced by the receipts it produces. A cipher of mutual approvals cannot survive the spot check, because each reviewer needs its own stake, and a pearl of real work is the only thing that clears it. Payout is a river that runs after that.
